title: Kissed Garlicky Filipino Pork Sisig
description: A garlicky and crispy Filipino dish featuring pork, red food coloring, and a variety of spices, pressure-cooked to perfection and served in a ramekin.
instructions: Pressure-cook the pork face until tender, then dice into small pieces.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat and saute the minced garlic until fragrant.
Add the diced onion and sliced chili peppers to the pan and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the cooked pork, red food coloring, calamansi juice, salt, and black pepper to the pan and stir-fry until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a ramekin and serve immediately.
Garnish with sliced green onions and a sprinkle of black pepper, if desired.
Serve with steamed rice or as a topping for nachos or tacos.
Refrigerate or freeze leftovers for up to 3 days.
Reheat the sisig in the microwave or on the stovetop before serving.
